scripts.build: tsc -b packages/provider-http packages/domain-intel packages/rdap packages/registrar packages/registrar-spaceship packages/registrar-namecheap packages/dns-plan packages/cloudflare-dns packages/pangolin-client && bun run build:editor
scripts.build:editor: tsc -b packages/editor-core packages/editor-renderer packages/editor-react && bun scripts/build-editor-css.ts
scripts.typecheck: bun run build && tsc -p tsconfig.json && tsc -p tsconfig.editor.json && bun run --filter './examples/*' typecheck
scripts.test: bun run build && bun test packages
scripts.playground: bun run build && bun --cwd examples/editor-playground dev
scripts.ci: bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build:examples && bun run verify:packages
